items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...He and Gigi Gryce, I think they came over there maybe -- maybe, I'm not sure, they may have come through there with Lionel Hampton's band? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, probably, but see, I couldn't have heard them because I was working too much here.

ctx.x: That's it, man. He comes with Quincy Jones' band. Now, this man --

Wait, one question. Did you happen to hear Clifford Brown when he was in Paris? He came to Paris '53, '52 or '53. He and Gigi Gryce, I think they came over there maybe -- maybe, I'm not sure, they may have come through there with Lionel Hampton's band?

Well, probably, but see, I couldn't have heard them because I was working too much here. But now Benny Bailey, now, I just come from the Casino de Paris, and they were sitting down there, Benny Bailey was sitting down there just as unconcerned. I always tried somebody to get me, see. They were mad because I was there so long. See, people get mad, 'What is he doing down there?' Kenny say, well, whatever he's doing down there, he's down there, so let him alone. Kenny's at the Blue Note, Don Byas is at the Blue…
